title: Vegan White Pizza: Recreating Dad's Favorite Anthony's-Style Broccoli Rabe and Sausage Pie

locations.name: Connecticut, USA
locations.basis: Explicit mention by the host: "here in Connecticut" during the intro.

locations.name: Guildford, CT (Anthony's Pizza)
locations.basis: Explicit mention in dialogue: "broccoli rob and sausage pizza from Anthony's in Guildford"; implies restaurant location, likely Guildford, CT (no independent confirmation in transcript).

summary: In this Goodful episode, Rachel in Connecticut attempts to veganize her dad’s favorite takeout pizza from a local restaurant, Anthony’s. The video walks through a from-scratch dough, a plant-based spicy sausage built from pressed tofu, mushrooms, and walnuts, and a cashew-based mozzarella. She parboils broccoli rabe as a topping and assembles a white-style pizza (no tomato sauce) brushed with olive oil. The bake is performed at a high temperature with a brief broil to brown the cheese. Throughout, her dad samples the finished pizza and provides enthusiastic feedback, validating the vegan recreations and the texture of the tofu sausage and cashew cheese. The video highlights key vegan-pizza techniques, including texture-boosting tofu handling, flavoring the sausage base, and achieving melt and chew with nut-based cheese.

sections.title: Dough preparation and initial resting
sections.description: The host combines water, olive oil, instant yeast, all-purpose flour, and salt. After mixing to eliminate dry spots, the dough rests for about five minutes, then is kneaded for 2–3 minutes before a second rest in a warm place for 60–90 minutes to double in size. The dough is then chilled for later use.

sections.title: Spicy vegan sausage base (tofu-mushroom-walnut)
concepts: mushrooms and walnuts as texture agents
seasoning: fennel, garlic, red pepper flakes
sections.description: Tofu is pressed, crumbled, and spread on a sheet, then frozen to enhance texture. A food processor blends walnuts into a paste, then adds garlic, fennel seeds, red pepper flakes, Worcestershire, apple cider vinegar, sugar, refined coconut oil, and salt. Crushed mushrooms are pulsed in, followed by cornstarch and all-purpose flour to increase chewiness. The mixture combines with the tofu and is cooked in a pan until browned.

sections.title: Cashew-based vegan mozzarella
sections.description: Cashews are blended with water, coconut oil, miso, nutritional yeast, tapioca starch, lemon juice, and salt to create a creamy vegan mozzarella sauce. This base is thickened by heating on the stove and then set aside to cool until ready to use.

sections.title: Pizza assembly (white-style)
sections.description: The dough is stretched to a roughly 10-inch circle, kept from sticking with cornmeal (instead of semolina). The base is brushed with olive oil, then dollops of mozzarella are scattered. The vegan sausage mixture and parboiled broccoli rabe with garlic are added, followed by more vegan cheese and a touch of salt. The pizza is prepared for baking without a traditional tomato sauce.

sections.title: Baking, finishing, and tasting
sections.description: The assembled pizza is baked at 500°F for about eight minutes and then broiled on low for 2–3 minutes to brown the cheese. After removal, a drizzle of olive oil finishes the dish. The host presents the pizza to her dad, who tests and rates it, noting that the textures—sausage, cheese, and broccoli rabe—are convincing and flavorful despite the absence of meat.
